metrics.top_category_examples: academic footnotes, programming books, multi-column IEEE layout, statistical tables — all 9.6/10

approved_claims: @pdf2md/core converts PDFs to Markdown at 9.2/10 average quality across 28 real-world test documents (academic papers, legal contracts, financial reports, government forms, resumes) — 28/28 successful conversions, entirely client-side, nothing leaves the browser.
Multi-column layouts, tagged-PDF structure, and heavily tabular documents (census data, financial statements) all scored 9.4+.
risk_notes: Re-run the quality suite before reuse if @pdf2md/core has shipped since 2026-03-30 — the score is tied to that version.
Don't claim 'AI-powered' — this is explicitly a non-AI, deterministic conversion tool; that's part of the trust pitch.
